assertions.name: json-determinism
assertions.detail: Repeated serialization must be byte-identical.

assertions.name: telemetry-inside-interval
assertions.detail: External value inside native interval must pass at distance zero.

assertions.name: telemetry-at-absolute-tolerance
assertions.detail: Exactly 64 MiB distance must pass.

assertions.name: telemetry-beyond-tolerance
assertions.detail: One byte beyond the applicable tolerance must fail.

assertions.name: telemetry-non-positive
assertions.detail: A non-positive capture must fail.

assertions.name: managed-negative-growth
assertions.detail: Negative retained growth must pass.

assertions.name: managed-exact-128mib
assertions.detail: Exactly 128 MiB retained growth must pass.

assertions.name: managed-128mib-plus-one
assertions.detail: 128 MiB plus one byte must fail.

assertions.name: managed-raw-diagnostic-only
assertions.detail: A high raw peak with low post-cleanup retention must pass.

assertions.name: sample-size-minimum
assertions.detail: Minimum 30 rounds to one complete four-block cycle (32).

assertions.name: sample-size-over-cap
assertions.detail: Over-cap requirement must preserve raw required n and cap candidate at 148.

assertions.name: williams-four-position-balance
assertions.detail: Four-row cycle must place every algorithm once in every position.

assertions.name: williams-four-predecessor-balance
assertions.detail: Four-row cycle must cover each ordered distinct predecessor pair once.

assertions.name: williams-two-balance
assertions.detail: Two-row cycle must reverse order.

assertions.name: block-plan-valid
assertions.detail: Valid block-plan vector must pass.

assertions.name: block-plan-duplicate-directory-rejected
assertions.detail: Duplicate child directory must be rejected by static validation.

assertions.name: block-plan-wrong-predecessor-rejected
assertions.detail: Wrong predecessor must be rejected.

assertions.name: block-plan-escape-rejected
assertions.detail: Escaping child path must be rejected.

assertions.name: source-native-api
assertions.detail: V2 source must contain the frozen native API/field mappings.

assertions.name: source-no-authoritative-process-properties
assertions.detail: V2 source must not use v1 zero-valued Process memory properties.

assertions.name: source-no-inline-cleanup-boundary
assertions.detail: V2 source must expose a non-inlined post-return cleanup boundary.

assertions.name: source-no-mutable-static-state
assertions.detail: Unexpected mutable static declarations: 0.

assertions.name: formal-root-absent
assertions.detail: Process-reuse formal root must remain absent.
